signal: Ridgeline launched Intelligent Operations in February 2026 and Market Intelligence in April, and surpassed $650B in committed AUM on its AI-native platform.

email.body1:
Paige, saw Ridgeline crossed $650B in committed AUM and shipped Intelligent Operations and Market Intelligence this year.

Momentum like that usually means more investment-management accounts in play than your team can work before they go quiet. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Ridgeline off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Paige, quick follow-up for Ridgeline.

As the AUM milestone draws more inbound, most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to convert it, so the coverage gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Ridgeline needs to hit target, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Paige, last bit of proof for Ridgeline.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your reply rate likely compares to other AI-native fintech teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Paige, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority while the new products roll out, no problem at all. A double product launch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an investment-management motion? I will tailor it to Ridgeline either way.
